title: Model pinning acceptance criteria and I/O sentinel
creator: Lena Park
description: Define an engineering-level acceptance contract and an automated I/O sentinel for pinned model releases. Goal: provide a machine-checkable spec and CI gating steps that assert backward compatibility of prompt formats, output shapes and semantics, public parameter aliases, and published performance profiles (latency/throughput/cost). This ticket owns the spec, test harness integration, and a minimal sentinel job that runs on every pinned release and rollout. The contract intentionally focuses on observable behavior and developer-facing parameter surface (not model training details).
tasks: Draft formal acceptance criteria for prompt shapes, required fields, and parameter aliases
Specify numeric tolerances for performance profile drift (p50/p95 latency, tokens/s, memory) and cost delta thresholds
Design semantic-output fingerprinting strategy (sampling + embedding similarity + label-concordance checks)
Implement sentinel harness that runs on CI and on Dedicated/Private rollout canaries
Add gating rules to onboarding pipeline: must pass functional, semantic, and perf checks before marking pinned version as GA
Wire failure alerts and rollback playbook into Console rollouts dashboard
acceptance_criteria: A machine-readable contract file format exists (JSON-LD or similar) describing required input schema, stable parameter aliases, and allowed output shape changes
CI sentinel job executes against a pinned model candidate and emits a pass/fail signal within the model onboarding pipeline
Functional tests validate that canonical prompt templates accepted by previous pinned version still produce outputs meeting contract rules (shape, required fields)
Semantic stability check: average embedding cosine similarity on a held prompt-set >= 0.86 and label-concordance >= 94% for classification-style outputs
Performance drift guardrails: p50 latency increase <= 15%, p95 <= 25%, throughput decrease <= 20% relative to published profile, otherwise fail onboarding
Parameter alias compatibility: legacy aliases still resolve to supported configuration values and surface-level parameter validation errors remain stable
On failure, the pipeline records a reproducible artifact (seeded inputs, outputs, diff) and posts a PR with suggested remediation steps
implementation_notes: Use existing regression harness from infra/regressions as the runner; add new check modules rather than reimplementing full runner
Leverage embedding model v2 for semantic fingerprinting; keep fingerprint dataset small (~500 prompts) to keep sentinel runtime <30m
Publish a per-model contract artifact to the model catalog (signed manifest) that Console reads for rollout enforcement
Start with conservative numeric thresholds; allow opt-in loosening by PM & Security with recorded justification and approval
Performance comparisons must be measured on stable instance types; CI will use a synthetic 'sentinel' hardware profile to normalize results
Record 'failure reason' enums to standardize dashboard displays and SLO impacts
